name: wakekit
description: Train a wake word for any language with TTS, run it in the browser. No GPU, no torch, no cloud.

scripts.build:sidecar: mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && swiftc -O src-tauri/stt-th.swift -o src-tauri/binaries/stt-th-aarch64-apple-darwin -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker src-tauri/stt-th-Info.plist && codesign -f -s - src-tauri/binaries/stt-th-aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && sed -i '' "s|'./worker.ts'|'./worker.js'|" lib/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build:lib && npm run selfcheck
scripts.selfcheck: esbuild src/selfcheck.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:onnxruntime-web > .wkc.mjs && node .wkc.mjs eval/clips; s=$?; rm -f .wkc.mjs; exit $s
